newsitem.title: THAILAND: COCO power generator damaged by fire.
newsitem.headline: COCO power generator damaged by fire.

text.p: The Cogeneration Plc said on Friday its new electricity generator was damaged by a fire while it was being installed and tested at southeastern Mab Ta Phud industrial estate.
Cogeneration told the Stock Exchange of Thailand that the fire on Thursday night did not cause any casualties or destroy other facilities at its new power production plant.
The company said it believed the fire was caused by a short circuit. It did not estimate the fire damage, saying it was covered by accident insurance.
